name: spryker-community/search-analyzer-config
description: Zed-editable per-store-index analyzer configuration (decompound words, synonyms, stopwords, stemmer language, do-not-decompound brand list), materialized via a search-index-alias rebuild.

scripts-descriptions.check-floors: Verifies the declared dependency floors are real: resolves every constraint to its oldest allowed version (production deps only) and asserts each vendor symbol used in src/ actually exists there.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Applies Rector's configured rule sets (PHP floor upgrades + level-0 dead-code/code-quality) to src/, tests/, and tools/.
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry-run: Shows what Rector would change without writing anything.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 8. Must be run from a host shop (see README) — needs the shop's generated Generated\Shared\Transfer\* classes and a freshly regenerated Ide/AutoCompletion stub, neither of which this package can produce standalone.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan-ci: Standalone CI variant of the phpstan check: generates just the Transfer classes this package needs (same generator the Portable test suite uses) and ignores the two categories of class that only exist inside a real host shop (Propel Orm\Zed\* models, the aggregated Ide\AutoCompletion stub) — see phpstan.ci.neon for exactly what's excluded and why.
scripts-descriptions.test-portable: Runs this package's own @group Portable test subset standalone — no host shop, no live database, no search engine. See README, 'Testing and CI'.
